name: Cemetery Mary
source:
Cemetery Mary is the story about a girl who loves visiting the cemetery.

When rumors of a serial killer start floating around town, she isn't too worried--that is, until her parents go missing. And in the wake of their disappearance, a message from an unknown number leaves Mary to wade through a sea of doubts and questions.

Unknown Number
Your parents are safe. [12:43 AM]

Is the rumored "Blackwood Butcher" playing some sort of sick prank? Or is something even more sinister responsible for their disappearance? Will she be able to find the identity of the mysterious killer, or the whereabouts of her parents?

Or will her meddling threaten to make her a permanent resident of the very cemetery she so admires?

[From [url=https://arcadekitten.itch.io/cemetery-mary]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《公墓玛丽》讲述了一个喜欢参观公墓的女孩的故事。

当连环杀手的谣言开始在镇上流传时，她并不太担心——直到她的父母失踪。在他们失踪后，一条来自未知号码的消息让玛丽陷入了怀疑和疑问的海洋中。

未知号码
你的父母很安全。[上午12:43]

难道传闻中的“黑木屠夫”在搞什么恶作剧？还是有更险恶的因素导致了他们的失踪？她能否找到神秘杀手的身份，或者父母的下落？

或者她的干预是否会威胁到她成为她如此崇拜的墓地的永久居民？
